# Demosaic scalar fixtures

Generated by `python3 scripts/demosaic_refvec.py`. C/C++ is compiled **only** under
`target/refvec/`; none enters Cargo. Sources are downloaded whole, unchanged and pinned:

- darktable `733bd69f32cac7ff5e41025115942772add1f088`, GPL-3.0-or-later:
  `common/darktable.h` SHA-256 `f5d0bbb8d22db4f502aa174d5b2046a4765d7209bca61d090169a7de9793af18`
  pins the working tiles (Markesteijn 122, LMMSE 136);
  `xtrans.c` SHA-256 `175898cb103295f07ed458cf9a2acd3ddb797b152aa58b3706a901ff0bcc2caa`;
  `lmmse.c` SHA-256 `8b60d1079038e83b25913cb1df353434d10fafd923498960817cee1c53792ec8`.
- RawTherapee `5f486d3678b34c74ba0c63571c17babe20935019`, GPL-3.0-or-later /
  original DCB BSD-3-Clause: `demosaic_algos.cc` SHA-256
  `de1bae94d451881a99e5c45e099ebcc24a9ffa91943fcd3b55671523f4649d49`.

The host shim provides allocation, serial OpenMP macros, CFA access, median sorting
and inert progress/border adapters. SIMD and compiler fast-math pragmas are disabled;
compilation uses `g++ -O2 -ffp-contract=off -U__SSE2__`. Kernel equations/order are unchanged.
Fixture values are little-endian f32 RGB. Input is the existing deterministic fixture
noise function, not camera/client photographs.

- `markesteijn/{dx}-{dy}.f32`: 257x251 mosaic, each of 36 standard X-Trans shifts,
  upstream TS=122, three passes, samples y=20..231 and x=20..237 at step 7 (2883 values).
  This spans the 88-pixel kept-tile boundaries. Rust matches exactly. The unused
  upstream final VNG border call is inert; samples exclude that 17-pixel border.
- `lmmse/{RGGB,BGGR,GRBG,GBRG}.f32`: 128x128, mode 2 (three medians, no EECI
  refinement), scaler 1, samples x/y=24..104 at step 3 (2187 values). Upstream
  zero/PPG borders are excluded; Rust uses a complete 16-pixel mirrored halo
  (upstream uses 12), retaining sensor samples. The 136-pixel working tile is unchanged.
- `dcb/{RGGB,BGGR,GRBG,GBRG}.f32`: same samples, three correction iterations and
  standard final chroma interpolation. RT numerical kernels are unchanged;
  storage/phase/tile-limit adapters provide the Rust port's mirrored 212x212 tile.

Updates: inspect upstream changes, change the script pin and SHA-256 list, regenerate
into target first, compare/investigate differences, then approve fixtures and update
PORTS/licences/report together. Do not blindly replace existing fixtures. All prior
AMaZE/RCD/VNG/highlights/capture fixtures remain unchanged.
